description: Put a story map, an ROI calculation, or a Wardley map of a Space with one outcome of that Space. With `bet` (the id or the label of a bet of a roadmap outcome), put a story map with that bet instead: it holds the stories for the bet. A document goes with one outcome or one bet at most, so a second call moves it. No document changes: the link is the only write. Needs the owner or editor role.

bet.description: A bet of that roadmap outcome, by id or by label. Only for a story map.

documentId.description: The story map, the ROI calculation, or the Wardley map.
The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

name: spaces_attach_to_outcome
title: Attach a document to an outcome or a bet
